name: The Celebrity Traitors
summary: Celebrity Mafia/Werewolf where hidden Traitors murder Faithful at night and Faithful banish suspects by day to win charity prize.
rules_text: One host secretly chooses a small number of Traitors, the rest are Faithful; only Traitors and the audience know who is who. Each day players do missions to build a prize pot and may win hidden shields giving immunity from murder. Each evening all meet at the Round Table, discuss suspicions, then vote; most votes is banished and reveals their role. Most nights Traitors meet privately and unanimously choose one Faithful to murder, who leaves without reveal and is announced next morning. Shields block murder but not banishment. After the final Round Table 2-4 players remain at the Fire of Truth. They may vote unanimously to end or banish again. When they end, roles are revealed: if all remaining are Faithful they share the pot, if any are Traitors the Traitors take it all.
